runtime.title: Runtime parameters
runtime.hint: Formerly environment variables, now file-backed config. Interval and adapter-mode changes apply immediately (the schedulers re-arm); goal auto-resume applies on the next restart.
runtime.roadmapTickHint: How often the roadmap of auto-sync projects is re-imported (e.g. from Jira) and checked for PRs merged directly on GitHub. E.g. 1 h → a new Jira issue shows up in the roadmap within an hour. 0 = disabled.
runtime.limitResumeMaxHint: How many times a limit-paused run is retried before it is parked/failed.
runtime.maxConcurrentRunsHint: How many task runs may work at once across every project. One slot per task run — a workflow counts once, however many agents it spawns. A run keeps its slot while it waits on an approval. The rest queue.
runtime.dockDoneTasksLimitHint: How many of the latest finished or failed tasks the Tasks panel shows.
runtime.goalAutoResumeHint: Enable for unattended (launchd) mode — running/limit-paused goals re-dispatch on restart. Off = they park and wait for approval (Law 3).
runtime.taskTickHint: How often ZIBBY checks scheduled tasks (those with a start time) and starts the ones that are due. E.g. 1 min → a task scheduled for 9:00 starts by 9:01 at the latest. 0 = disabled.
runtime.channelTickHint: How often ZIBBY pulls new messages from Slack, email, calendar and other connected channels and triages them (reply, task, notify only). E.g. 12 h → checks twice a day; a message from 13:00 waits for the next check. 0 = disabled.
runtime.monitorTickHint: How often ZIBBY checks CI/CD status (GitHub Actions) and starts an investigation task for a new red run. E.g. 15 min → a broken build is noticed within a quarter of an hour. 0 = disabled.
runtime.automationTickHint: How often cron automations are evaluated. Cron has minute precision, so keep this at 1 min — a longer interval skips runs (e.g. at 5 min a cron “every day at 8:02” never fires). 0 = disabled.
runtime.limitResumeTickHint: How often ZIBBY looks for runs paused by an exhausted token limit and resumes them once headroom is back. E.g. 5 min → work resumes within 5 minutes of the limit resetting. 0 = disabled.
